Subject: Your geographical-indication dispute matter

Dear Ms. Kamath,

Thank you for meeting us on 27 March 2025 about your dispute with M/s Crescent Exports. As we understand it, the rival product uses the protected regional name on its label. The matter is listed before the Bombay High Court.

Our advice is to rely on the registered GI certificate and seek an injunction against the infringing label. Please collect the registered GI certificate and samples of the infringing label and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Aditi Ranganathan
